MULT_PROCESS.label: The multiplier process: initial injection raises income, which raises further spending in successive rounds

stages.name: The multiplier
stages.title: The multiplier
stages.sub: How the size of the multiplier is calculated, what drives it, and why it matters for AD and the wider economy.

steps.hint: Think about what fraction leaks out of the round of spending versus what stays circulating.
